data: Deterministic synthetic events; no user conversations or model calls.
notes: Run 1 is exploratory: discard sub-millisecond preview/list timings affected by clock quantization.
Run 2 batches preview and listing operations; their quantiles describe per-batch operation averages.
No host, operating-system, processor or hardware identifiers are included.
Timings are local warm-cache measurements, not production capacity or mobile-network latency.
